digest.component_or_area: Rebar Agent S3 Pydantic-boundary operation accounting
propositions: Successful Agent runs must report aggregate usage (requests, output tokens) across all retry attempts in a single durable JSONL row without per-attempt rows or rejected-attempt subtraction.

Validation exhaustion must re-raise the identical original StructuredOutputError object recovered from the UnexpectedModelBehavior cause chain; repeated-truncation exhaustion with no Rebar object on the chain must construct a fresh UnretryableOutputError as the defined fallback.
Terminal failure diagnostics must preserve consumed requests and provider-reported tokens without creating fictional usage for calls that reported none.
Parse-failure artifacts, when enabled, must store only the complete final provider response at terminal failure, never capturing earlier truncated responses from the retry wire.
Existing pricing and usage reporting must remain byte-compatible apart from higher post-retry counters; no new core usage fields or candidate_requests competing fields may be introduced.
